label: Local 149

events.title: OLMS compliance audit
events.body: An OLMS Compliance Audit Program review of Local 149. Search indexes describe findings around missing credit card statements and inadequate documentation of expenses, with Dan Brejc as Secretary-Treasurer. NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED — dol.gov blocks automated retrieval. Open the source and confirm before publishing.

events.title: Local 149 dissolved
events.body: Final OLMS filing. Membership had declined from 640 in 2005 to 458 in 2013. Assets and officers carried into the merged local.
